text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion invited me to a tea party.
Apparently she's hosting it to deepen her bonds
with the academy's students, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, thank you for the invitation.
Delicious black tea, chatting with a friend...
A truly worthwhile gathering, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And so, I've prepared a potion to make this gathering even more delightful! What do you think? Aren't you interested? Of course you are!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hell no, I ain't drinkin' that!
We just started, what are you tryin' to push on me?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong, Cafe?
Curious about that wall over there?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's really nothing...
all that important, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Over there... there's someone...
I don't recognize...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Cafe, you have such strong spiritual sight! Must be nice, what kind of people can you see?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Could it be a fairy?
A Japanese fairy? Like a zashiki-warashi, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It doesn't seem like... that's the vibe at all, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then, could it be the ghost?
I might've met that one at the castle!
Maybe, at least!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, let me join in too! I happen to be
quite interested in fields that science has
yet to explain!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, look at you guys... Amazes me how hyped
you can get over something so uncertain—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ngh, GAAAAH!? What the hell?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukku, that's my tail.
My, what a splendid reaction,
wouldn't you say, Shakur-kun?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Y-You bastard...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but I'm glad!
Because being scared means you really believe in it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Who're you saying is scared!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't be mad!
I'm just really happy that you believe
in the same things we do, Shakur♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whew, taking a break for now~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! I was just thinking a bit.
...I bet the old me would be super surprised to hear this~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd be laughing with a friend until we're exhausted.
...I mean—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've spent so much time daydreaming
about what kind of conversations
I could have with girls my own age—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, something beyond imagination is happening right before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"How could I not be having fun?
Besides, the Umamusume here are
all so uniquely charming and exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Learning through interactions
with Umamusume of her own generation...
Fine Motion's study abroad certainly seems to have great value.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "And so—let's embrace this fatigue! How about we head into Round 2?♪"
choice_data_list: Let's have fun as long as our stamina lasts!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I've always been a bit proud of my
light footwork, maybe? ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes there was!
I kept having tea with everyone wherever I went, and before I knew it, I had no room left for dinner...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm! Come to think of it, we didn't prepare
any Irish tea leaves for this tea party, did we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright♪ While we're at it,
let's go buy it right now! All the way to the specialty shop in the next town over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pat pat)

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: ......May fortune favor you in battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Girding myself, I set off after her,
guided by the clue of a specialty shop in the next town."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
When I'm having fun, my stamina is boundless, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hey!
What the heck is this smoke!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, hahaha! It seems the earlier concoction
has taken effect far sooner than anticipated...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...This is the worst... *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah, wonder what happened?
Trainer, I'll head back first, okay♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion runs off, full of excitement.
It seems her source of energy is truly bottomless...
